hash_policy.text_inputs: Fields containing lf_utf8_sha256 hash strict UTF-8 text after CRLF and remaining CR are replaced with LF. All other characters, BOMs, whitespace and trailing blank lines are preserved.
hash_policy.raw_bytes: Archive, original/port resource-pair, probe/executable, resource-payload and decoded-script hashes remain SHA-256 of exact bytes; no text normalization applies.
hash_policy.derived_records: ADS block_commands_sha256 hashes JSON-serialized derived command records with sorted keys, excluding offsets, the containing ADS tag number and TAG commands.
hash_policy.generated_reports: JSON and Markdown are emitted as UTF-8 with LF line endings. Scoped .gitattributes rules preserve LF for the two checked-in inventory reports.

scope: Local port and original resource/script inventory; static reachability; no original runtime/render parity assertion.
assessment_method: Command-support notes and scheduler interpretation are manually reviewed; source hashes identify the reviewed snapshot. Re-review them after source changes.

golden_dump.scope: Port decoder regression only; not original executable rendering parity.

fan_crosswalk.scope: Grouped candidates cover source observations, not distinct animation counts or original visual parity. All fan records retain secondary_unverified status.
